definitions: Cannabis sativa, a widely consumed form of cannabis.

blocks.text: "Sativa" is a song by American singer-songwriter Jhené Aiko from her second studio album, Trip (2017). The track features a guest appearance from Swae Lee and was released on September 22, 2017, by Def Jam Recordings. A remix, including additional vocals from Slim Jxmmi of Rae Sremmurd, was released in January 2018.

Sativa, sativus, and sativum are Latin botanical adjectives meaning cultivated. It is often associated botanically with plants that promote good health and used to designate certain seed-grown domestic crops.
